Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first.

This is the mechanism that makes the live demo rehearsable. Every break
the presenter performs is a named script with a matching reset. Nothing
is typed live.

Objective
---------
Chaos manifests and the scripts that drive the demo.

Deliverables
------------
- manifests/chaos-dns-block.yaml   CiliumNetworkPolicy
- scripts/break.sh                 usage: break.sh <latency|errors|dns|ok|baseline>
- scripts/reset.sh                 full demo namespace reset to beat 0
- scripts/preflight.sh             must pass before the room opens
- manifests/loadgen.yaml           steady ~20 rps against frontend
- images/hey/Dockerfile             reproducible self-contained hey image when no official image is published
- docs/demo-runbook.md             the beat sheet

The DNS break — this is the money beat
--------------------------------------
Use a CiliumNetworkPolicy, NOT the application's /chaos?mode=dns.

manifest: api-deny-dns, namespace demo, endpointSelector app=api,
egressDeny to kube-dns on UDP and TCP 53. Annotate it:
  demo/owner: chaos
  demo/expires: session-end

The point of the policy version: the policy caues the failure AND the
observability layer proves the policy is enforced. Both the deny and the
subsequent allow are visible as verdicts in Hubble. That is the argument
the demo is making.

scripts/break.sh
----------------
case latency    -> call /chaos?mode=slow on backend
case errors     -> call /chaos?mode=error on backend
case dns        -> kubectl apply the CiliumNetworkPolicy
case ok         -> reset all /chaos modes to ok, delete the policy
case baseline   -> same as ok, plus delete and re-create the loadgen pod,
                   so the run always starts from an identical state

Every action prints a single human-readable line: what changed and what
to look at next. The presenter reads these aloud if they lose their place.

scripts/reset.sh
----------------
Delete the demo namespace and re-apply everything, in order:
demo app, loadgen, alert rules, traffic annotations. Then run break.sh
baseline. Must complete in under 60 seconds and be fully idempotent.

scripts/preflight.sh
--------------------
Exit non-zero and print exactly what is missing if any of:
  registry reachable at registry.lab.local:5000
  cilium agent DaemonSet fully ready
  prometheus, loki, tempo all ready
  perses reachable
  demo namespace exists with all pods Running
Then run break.sh baseline and print one line:
  ✓ preflight passed — demo ready

docs/demo-runbook.md
--------------------
The full beat sheet: 9 beats, minute marks, what to do, what to say,
which screen to be on. Include explicit cut lines — which beats to drop
if running long, in priority order — and state that the DNS beat is never
cut.

Acceptance
----------
Run: reset.sh && preflight.sh && break.sh dns
Then, within 10 seconds, `hubble observe --namespace demo --verdict
DROPPED --last 20` shows dropped DNS flows. Then `break.sh ok` and the
same command shows the flows allowed again. Report the timestamps for
both.
